verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at the site root and a docs index at /docs/llms.txt, and documentation pages are served as Markdown (.md) for agent consumption. The CLI onboarding page also explicitly says you can hand it to your coding agent to run setup, so the docs are deliberately agent-oriented. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt bundle.
